levels.title: Menu Basics
levels.oneSentenceGoal: Recognize simple menu language and identify common food and drink items.

levels.title: Ordering Basics
levels.oneSentenceGoal: Place a short polite order for one item or drink.

levels.title: Server Interaction
levels.oneSentenceGoal: Handle the first server prompt, small follow-up questions, and one or two basic requests.

levels.title: Paying and Finishing
levels.oneSentenceGoal: Ask for the check, recognize simple payment language, and close the interaction naturally.
